rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=6, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, grad_clip=0.5, lr=0.0001, unet_c=16, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-8 CEILING-CONFIRMATION PROBE: ONE knob grad_clip 1.0->0.5 on the iter-4 PEAK cfg (ep6, lr=1e-4, c16, n_iter300, val_n16, seed42 -> 0.9596). NOT-yet-tried axis = per-scan Adam GRADIENT-CLIP STRENGTH; it perturbs the per-scan optimization trajectory stability WITHOUT touching any read knob (val_n/seed fixed), so the comparison to 0.9596 stays apples-to-apples (unlike val_n, which would change which/how-many scans are scored, or warm_start=off, which flips the whole regime rather than probing a single knob). Failure-mode recap: ALL working levers EXHAUSTED -- per-scan lr 1e-3->1e-4 PINS each GT-free split-view fit to its warm-start init (iter-3 0.9553->0.9593); n_iter is NOT the lever (iter-2 n_iter600 DROPPED to 0.9407, no per-scan early-stop -> overfit); warm-start INIT saturated (ep3->6 0.9593->0.9596 but 6->12 REGRESSED to 0.9585, iter-5); CAPACITY is not the lever (iter-6 c16->c32 0.9596->0.9495); and SEED is noise-stable (iter-7 seed42->123 0.9596->0.9588, within noise). grad_clip=1.0 is the mandatory floor below which the 2304-view FBP adjoint can overflow on Mayo, but breast is 128-view (denser, smaller adjoint norm) so 0.5 should be SAFE and is the last untried optimization-stability axis. Hypothesis: 0.9596 is a SUBSTRATE FBP-bound ceiling (hr=0, < the 128-view LD-FBP baseline), so a tighter grad_clip lands WITHIN NOISE of 0.9596 -- documenting that the ~0.96 per-image U-Net N2I breast ceiling is gradient-clip-insensitive and structurally FBP-bounded, not an optimization-stability artefact, toward the iter-20 mandate. A material drop instead would mean the per-scan fit needs the looser clip to converge (an under-conditioning failure mode worth noting); a material LIFT would mean the per-scan trajectory was being over-clipped (capacity to climb after all). Wall: iter-4 (ep6,c16,gc1.0) ran 468s; identical cfg except grad_clip changes nothing about FLOPs/iters -> est ~470-500s, well under the 900s/15min wall (outer_wall_s=1500 hard cap).
